description: Who may open the app's pre (its private test version at play.neblla.com/pre/<slug or id>/): Neblla accounts let in by email and links with a password for people without an account, each with its expiry. `local`: { key, tag } is the app's local key: a page on localhost (the developer's machine) opens only the app's pre, and only with the tag <script src=".../connect/app/_<appId>?pa=<key>">. Changes nothing; neblla_pre_access adds, removes and revokes.
name: neblla_pre_access_read
title: Pre access (read)
